summary: The admitted blind-on-ice recording reached invent.c:look_here's ice-description branch with mention_decor enabled, where JavaScript used ICE without importing it. Importing the existing source constant restores the previous-decoration condition; the full recording now matches.

source.branch: Upstream invent.c:look_here (4104-4315) handles blind interaction with ice separately: after identifying actual ICE terrain, it calls force_decor(FALSE) when mention_decor is off or the previous decoration is already ICE, then prints the tactile ice message and skips the later feature description.
source.javascript: js/invent.js:dolook calls look_here; its blind ice branch uses is_ice(ux, uy, state), then checks state.iflags.prev_decor === ICE. invent.js now imports the existing ICE constant from const.js.
callers: cmd.c ':' -> dolook -> invent.c:look_here; js/cmd.js:runLookCommand -> js/invent.js:dolook -> js/invent.js:look_here
dependencies: const.js already exports the source ICE terrain constant; no new helper or state mapping is needed.
source.resolution: Import ICE from js/const.js and preserve the source order and previous-decoration condition.

evidence: The admitted v70 evaluation reports 0/178 screens matched and ReferenceError: ICE is not defined. The recorded colon command reaches blind look_here on actual ice with mention_decor enabled; the C branch checks previous decoration before force_decor and the tactile message.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:look_here (4191-4197) compares SURFACE_AT to ICE and iflags.prev_decor to ICE. js/invent.js has the corresponding condition and now imports ICE from js/const.js.
After adding the import, the focused bounded scan emitted and matched all 178/178 screens, RNG calls, cursors, and the input boundary through segment 0 step 177. No unported callees were reached.
